segments.contextAfter: `flags`: The options to use when applying the rotation. To instruct the function to return the minimum size of the workspace memory, set the [`kvImageGetTempBufferSize`](kvimagegettempbuffersize.md) flag. To specify how vImage handles pixel locations beyond the edge of the source image, set one of the following flags: [`kvImageBackgroundColorFill`](kvimagebackgroundcolorfill.md) or [`kvImageEdgeExtend`](kvimageedgeextend.md). If you want vImage to use a higher quality but a slower resampling filter, set the [`kvImageHighQualityResampling`](kvimagehighqualityresampling.md) flag. If your code implements its own tiling or its own multithreading, pass [`kvImageDoNotTile`](kvimagedonottile.md). This function ignores the [`kvImageLeaveAlphaUnchanged`](kvimageleavealphaunchanged.md) flag.
